labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected behaviour (deadlock) with stdout/stderr redirection.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example; a minimal reproduction and rich.diagnose output are needed.

body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To look into the deadlock, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces it: a short script with `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` and a background thread or task that prints or logs during rendering. Stack dumps alone can't be run, so the example is what we need.

Please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose` from the environment where it hangs. The Rich version you listed is 14.2.0, so the diagnose output will confirm it.

The redirection behaviour is documented in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst#redirecting-stdout--stderr

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
